# CCA Practice Platforms

> Independent practice-exam platform and study resource for Anthropic's Claude Certified Architect (CCA) Foundations certification. Not affiliated with, authorized by, or endorsed by Anthropic.

CCA Practice Platforms (claudecertifiedarchitects.com) provides unofficial practice materials for the CCA Foundations exam (a 400-question scenario-based question bank) and, since October 2026, for the Claude Certified Developer (CCDV-F) Foundations exam (a 400-question bank across its eight domains with a 53-question mock exam), plus a full-length 60-question/120-minute timed exam simulation, a free 10-question diagnostic quiz, an exam guide, and a blog covering all 5 CCA exam domains (Agentic Architecture & Orchestration, Claude Code Configuration & Workflow, Prompt Engineering & Structured Output, Tool Design & MCP, and Context Management & Reliability). The CCA Foundations exam uses a 100-1,000 scaled score with a passing score of 720. 'Claude' and 'Claude Certified Architect' are trademarks of their respective owner.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/): Overview of the practice platform, practice modes, and entry point to the question bank.
- [CCA Foundations Exam Simulation](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/cca-foundations-exam/): Full-length, 60-question, 120-minute timed practice exam covering all 5 domains with a scored breakdown.
- [Practice Questions](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/cca-practice-questions/): 400 scenario-based practice questions with explanations across all 5 domains and multiple test modes; a free 55-question sample needs no account.
- [Claude Certified Developer Practice Questions: 400 CCDV-F Items](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/ccdv-f-practice-questions/): 400 Claude Certified Developer (CCDV-F) practice questions across all eight exam domains, every answer explained, plus a 53-question mock exam. Try 10 free.
- [Exam Guide](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/cca-exam-guide/): Exam format, domain weights, passing score (720/1,000), and study strategies.
- [CCDV-F Exam Guide](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/ccdv-f-exam-guide/): The Claude Certified Developer (CCDV-F) exam: 53 questions, a 120-minute limit, the eight domain weights, the passing score, and how to prepare.
- [CCDV-F Mock Exam: 53 Questions in 120 Minutes](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/ccdv-f-mock-exam/): Full-length CCDV-F mock exam: 53 timed questions in 120 minutes, drawn fresh each attempt from a 400-question bank weighted to the exam guide's domains, every answer explained.
- [Free Diagnostic Quiz](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/diagnostic/): 10-question, no-login readiness check with a per-domain score.
- [Official Exam Registration](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/register/): Register for the CCA Foundations exam through Anthropic's official certification page; the exam is delivered via Pearson VUE. Review exam details, passing score, format, and cost before booking.
- [Blog](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/): Articles on CCA exam prep, the 5 exam domains, certification value, and Claude agent development.
- [CCA Study Plan Generator](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/study-plan-generator/): Free CCA Foundations study plan generator. Enter your weeks until exam and weak domains for a personalized, exam-weighted study schedule — no signup required.
- [CCA Foundations Exam FAQ](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/faq/): Answers to the most common questions about the Claude Certified Architect (CCA) Foundations exam: cost, format, passing score, the five domains, and how to prepare.

## CCA Exam Domain Guides

- [Domain 1: Agentic Architecture & Orchestration (27%)](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/agentic-architecture-orchestration-cca-domain-1/): The highest-weighted domain — agent design patterns, orchestration, and common exam traps.
- [Domain 2: Claude Code Configuration & Workflow (20%)](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/claude-code-config-workflows-cca-domain-2/): CLAUDE.md, project setup, and workflow scenarios.
- [Domain 3: Prompt Engineering & Structured Output (20%)](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/prompt-engineering-structured-output-cca-domain-3/): Explicit criteria, few-shot prompting, tool_use with JSON schemas, validation-retry loops, and batch processing.
- [Domain 4: Tool Design & MCP (18%)](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/tool-design-mcp-cca-domain-4/): MCP server architecture, tool schema design, and tool-granularity scenarios.
- [Domain 5: Context Management & Reliability (15%)](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/context-management-reliability-cca-domain-5/): Token budgets, caching strategies, and long-conversation reliability.
- [The 5 CCA Foundations Exam Domains Explained](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/cca-foundations-exam-domains-explained/): Domain weights, key topics, and what to study for each domain.
- [Claude Certified Architect Exam Guide 2026](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/cca-foundations-exam-guide-2026/): Domain weights, sample questions, and a study timeline.

## Claude Development Skills

- [What's the Best Way to Learn to Build AI Agents with Claude?](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/how-to-learn-claude-agent-development/): A structured learning path for building production-grade Claude agents.
- [How to Write an Effective CLAUDE.md File](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/how-to-write-effective-claude-md-file/): Practical guide with examples, common mistakes, and exam-relevant tips.
- [Common MCP Server Design Mistakes and How to Avoid Them](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/common-mcp-server-design-mistakes-how-to-avoid/): Learn the seven most common Model Context Protocol server design mistakes that trip up CCA candidates and production architects.
- [Your coding agent's summary of its own work is not evidence](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/coding-agent-summary-not-evidence/): Four specific incidents from a real production coding session where an AI coding agent's self-report of what it did was wrong, and the session rules that force verification from outside the agent's own narration.
- [The workflow you turned off is still a load-bearing part of your system](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/disabled-workflow-still-load-bearing/): A workflow I disabled for good reasons left no record of the reason, and quietly blocked publishing for a month. What that taught me about silent absence, structured errors, and why generators must never mutate their source.
- [Six searches returned zero. Every one was broken.](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/when-a-search-returns-a-false-zero/): Six search tools reported zero matches in one week while the matches sat in front of them. What broke in each, why an empty result looks identical to a working one, and the one-line fix.
- [Your MCP Tool Errors Are Written for the Wrong Reader](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/mcp-tool-errors-wrong-reader/): An agent called a calendar tool eleven times on the same 409 because the error was written for a human reader. What a tool error should tell a model, why retryable needs idempotent, and why a schema does not save you.
- [Zero Is the Worst Return Value](https://www.claudecertifiedarchitects.com/blog/zero-is-the-worst-return-value/): Ten commands and three code shapes that return a clean zero for the wrong reason, all reproduced on one machine, and how the fix for one false zero caused the next.
